title: centella repanda var. floridana
intro: Centella repanda var. floridana, commonly known as Gotu Kola, is a type of plant that belongs to the Centella genus and is native to Southeast Asia. It has been used for centuries in traditional medicine to promote overall health and well-being, with reported health benefits including improved cognitive function, enhanced wound healing, and reduced inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Gotu Kola include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and neuroprotective effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as asiatic acid, madecassic acid, and brahmoside. These constituents contribute to the plant's ability to modulate immune response, improve memory and learning, and protect against oxidative stress.
